_meanings:
.²1 To receive, accept, take.
.²2 To acquire, obtain; {#BUryA pitAmahopAttA nibanDo dravyameva ca#}

 <ls>Y. 2. 121</ls>.
.²3 To give to, furnish with; {#upAdade tasya sahasraraSmiH#}; <ls>Ku. 7. 41</ls>.
.²4 To take, appropriate to oneself, assume; {#madalOlyamupAdade#} <ls>Śi. 6. 23</ls>.
.²5 To take away or off, carry away; steal.
.²6 To seize, attack; <ls>Pt. 3. 154</ls>.
.²7 To take, lay hold of; {#DanuraDijyamanADirupAdade#} <ls>R. 9. 54</ls>; to draw (water)
.²8 To assume a form.
.²9 To feel, perceive, experience; {#upAttaharzEH puMskokilEH#} <ls>Rs. 6. 21</ls>.
.²10 To consider, regard.
.²11 To take in addition, include, comprise; {#atra tElaSabdastilaBavasneharUpamuKyArTamupAdAya#}
 {#sArzapAdisnehezu vartate#} <ls>S. D. 2</ls>.
.²12 To employ, apply, use; {#yatparasya kutsArTamupAdIyate#} <ls>Mbh.</ls>
.²14 To undertake, begin; as in {#upAttayajYaH#}; {#prajAsargamupAdArya#} <ls>Mb. 12. 228. 49</ls>.
.²15 To mention, enumerate; {#iti pUrvasUtropAttAnAm#} <ls>Sk.</ls>
.²1 To cause to use, apply or employ.
